summary: Beltrami County, MN: tower moved in 2004 from the original Pinewood site to the county fairgrounds in Bemidji; standing and open to climbers during the county fair.

access.note: On the Beltrami County Fairgrounds; open to the public during the county fair, with climbing limited to four people at a time; the Pioneer also says the tower is open by appointment from May 1 to Oct. 1

visit.trail_note: Climbing is allowed during the county fair, four people at a time, per the Bemidji Pioneer; the Pioneer also says the tower and Forest Education Center are open by appointment from May 1 to Oct. 1. No other climbing rules were found

events.note: Moved by Dave Quam from the Pinewood site to the Beltrami County Fairgrounds, paid for with private donations

corrections.why: Quam's 2019 chapter report says he moved the tower in 2004; the record leaves the move undated.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Pioneer calls the building the Forest Education Center; the lookout list and the record say Forestry Education Center. The record's name is kept in the story.

notes_for_editor: No build date, maker or design statement was found in the sources read, so the story has no build section and says so. The Pioneer gives 80 ft to the platform and 90 ft to the roof top; height_m uses the platform figure. The Pioneer article's year is not shown and the fair dates are left out. The first draft missed the Pioneer's by-appointment access from May 1 to Oct. 1; the story and access note now include it. Quam's 2019 report and the FFLA list agree on the 2004 move and the Tower Gone / Tower Standing entries. The Quam history page (Page336) has no Pinewood entry. Budget: two WebSearch calls; about five distinct pages read, with the FFLA list and the Pioneer article each read a second time with a narrower grep. A 2007 chapter report snippet also gives the 2004 move, but it was not read and is not cited.
